limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.
Yahoo auto-adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not issuer NAV authority.
Macro and event snapshots are prospective context only; holdings, futures-curve, FX and tax inputs are absent.

methodology.curve: month-end historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded fresh catalysts, decaying persistent sentiment, historical analogs, risk, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

DEFENSE_ORDERS.rationale: Concrete procurement and capital actions: Belgium's Skyranger order, Stellantis-Brampton sale to Roshel, Neros drone expansion via $450M Pentagon loan, Rocket Lab's $150M OSC loan, Safran-MSI counter-drone tie-up, AIA-Israeli weapons deal, and Canada's defence spending surge. Excluded sports 'defense', impeachment politics, and promotional/stock items.

ECONOMIC_GROWTH.rationale: October payrolls (165k, 4.1% unemployment) is the headline macro data point; jobless claims low, Hungarian contraction, Taiwan's raised GDP estimate, Nigeria/Romania debt ratios, EU services output, and Thailand investment target are distinct verifiable data. Excluded stock-picking and recession-speculation pieces.

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: Oil sinking on Iran restraint, the Khor Mor gas-field drone strike, LNG demand shifting after Qatar disruption, and the collapsing Russian-oil import deal are material supply/price events; LNG carrier market lead change, Egypt gas deal, Iran fuel-conservation, and EU emissions decline are secondary but market-relevant. Dropped stock-picking, local pump-price, and promotional items.

FINANCIAL_STRESS.rationale: Children's Place bankruptcy and Victoria's credit-rating warning are verified corporate/sovereign stress; S&P on EM credit slowdown, BoE's AI financial-stability warning, rising card delinquencies, and softer loan-demand funding costs are distinct systemic signals. Dropped stock ratings and unrelated 'CDS' homonyms.

HEALTH_POLICY.rationale: FDA GLP-1 eye-risk label change and first dual-targeted HNSCC therapy are pharma-relevant verified actions; NC Medicaid expansion, a court blocking a Medicaid work-requirement rule, India's drug-price cuts, the FDA brain-met device rejection, and Australia's Medicare AI-breach watchdog are distinct policy events. Excluded enrollment advice columns and local funding items.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: Trump signaling de-escalation of Iran conflict is the highest-transmission event (energy risk premium, broad risk sentiment), corroborated by multiple outlets; sanctions on Iran arms, North Korea war-prep, Russian missile tests, Kyrgyz bank de-risking, and West Bank violence are distinct verified state actions with global relevance. Excluded crime/celebrity/sports and pure opinion.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: The US CPI print (shutdown-distorted annual rate) and Fed implications dominate global ETF decisions; Nigeria, China, Namibia inflation readings and Banxico's rate-cut debate are distinct national policy signals, alongside ECB's professional-forecaster survey. Excluded bank-note art and political commentary.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: Israel's presidential mandate to Eisenkot and Nigeria's disputed Tinubu election are top political shocks; Utah/California flood emergencies and Colorado wildfire-prevention power cuts are verified physical disruptions; quakes, the US shutdown standoff, and Hurricane Ernesto/Bermuda landfall add distinct risk events. Excluded metaphor headlines and fundraisers.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Central-bank gold buying outpacing 2025 and the post-election gold/silver rally are the core macro-precious signal; bullish price outlooks, Barrick's higher-price profit, Allied Gold's first pour, Australian resource growth, and record Indian electronic gold receipts add distinct verified detail. Excluded mining stock promos, 'gold' wordplay, and scams.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Voters rejecting data centers in 40 of 41 measures plus state tax-exemption repeals is a material policy inflection for AI-infrastructure ETFs; federal data-center permitting/energy legislation, Anthropic's 1.7GW turbine deal, Nvidia chips piling up in Hong Kong, Samsung's US fab trial run, and Mitsui chip-materials buyout are distinct verified events. Excluded CEO-scandal gossip and stock-picking.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: China extending tariff and rare-earth pauses (plus USTR Section 301 extension) is the key global trade signal; Canada's 100% China EV tariff, new US solar tariffs, Canadian steel-tariff relief extension, and China's zero-tariff Africa program are concrete policy changes. Excluded opinion columns and local utility tariff items.
